name: Plumber
description: Certified cooperative plumbers for leak repairs, tap fitting, pipeline blockages, and sanitary installations.
sample_steps: Worker inspects source of leakage or blockage
Explains repair work & any required spares
Tests water flow & ensures zero leakage
safety_note: Workers carry insulated tools and sanitised equipment. Main water supply will be temporarily turned off during high-pressure line repairs.
trust_note: All plumbers are verified through Delhi Labour Cooperative Society and carry active accidental insurance.

extra_work.title: Heavy-Duty Brass Valve Replacement
extra_work.description: The existing internal valve thread is severely corroded. Requires replacing with an ISI-certified brass fitting to prevent recurring leaks.

helper_request.reason: Main water pipeline excavation and heavy pressure joint alignment requires a second technician.

name: Electrician
description: Licensed electrical technicians for switchboard repairs, short circuits, MCB fixing, wiring, and appliance connections.
safety_note: 100% adherence to electrical safety protocol. Main MCB will be tripped before handling live load wires.
trust_note: Certified by State Electrical Licensing Board & supported by Cooperative Welfare Fund.

extra_work.title: 32A C-Curve MCB & Fire-Retardant Conduit Joint
extra_work.description: Main phase terminal shows burn marks from heavy load overheating. Requires replacing damaged terminal with 32A C-Curve MCB.

helper_request.reason: Pulling 4-core power cables through ceiling conduit piping requires second technician on ladder.

name: Cleaner
description: Deep home & kitchen cleaning, bathroom sanitisation, floor scrubbing, and post-event dusting by cooperative teams.
safety_note: Child-safe, pet-friendly cleaning agents used. Mask and gloves worn throughout.
trust_note: Fair wage guaranteed (80% direct to worker) through local Women Self-Help Cooperative.

extra_work.title: Balcony Tile Acid-Free Descaling & Machine Buffing
extra_work.description: Heavy mineral scaling and hard water residue on balcony floor requires specialized eco-descaling agent and mechanical buffing.

name: Carpenter
description: Master carpenters for furniture assembly, hinge fixes, door alignment, lock repair, and custom woodwork adjustments.
safety_note: Proper protective eye gear used during power sawing and cutting.
trust_note: Artisans registered under Traditional Craftsmen Cooperative Union.

extra_work.title: Hydraulic Soft-Close Hinges & Channel Realignment
extra_work.description: Door hinge bracket has snapped inside the wooden ply. Requires pair of heavy-gauge hydraulic soft-close hinges and wood filler anchor.

helper_request.reason: Holding and mounting heavy solid-wood wardrobe doors requires second artisan support.

name: Painter
description: Wall touch-ups, moisture patch treatments, interior accent wall painting, and waterproofing coats.
safety_note: Non-toxic, low-VOC odourless paints recommended for interior rooms.
trust_note: Backed by the National Painters Cooperative with price transparency.

extra_work.title: Waterproofing Polymer Putty & Anti-Damp Coating
extra_work.description: Efflorescence moisture patch detected under plaster. Requires scraping, anti-fungal barrier coat and 2 layers of waterproof polymer putty.

helper_request.reason: Setting up double-tier scaffolding and floor sheet masking for high ceiling walls.

name: Caregiver
description: Compassionate elder assistance, patient mobility support, vital monitoring, and companion care by trained workers.
safety_note: Police-verified and background-checked caregivers trained in geriatric first aid.
trust_note: Operated through Healthcare Worker Cooperative Alliance.

extra_work.title: Extended Vital Monitoring & Assisted Mobility Session
extra_work.description: Additional 60-minute specialized physical therapy walking assistance and hourly blood oxygen/glucose tracking.

name: Technician
description: Expert electro-mechanical diagnosis and repair for ACs, washing machines, refrigerators, inverters, RO purifiers & motors.
safety_note: Certified technicians with surge protection gear and refrigerant recovery bags.
trust_note: Standardised cooperative rate card ensures zero hidden or inflated charges.

extra_work.title: Dual-Run Compressor Capacitor & Gas Top-Up
extra_work.description: Faulty starting capacitor caused compressor thermal cutoff. Requires new ISI capacitor replacement and refrigerant top-up.

helper_request.reason: Dismounting heavy outdoor AC compressor unit or moving double-door refrigerator requires second technician.

name: Domestic Helper
description: Verified household support for daily chores, dishwashing, meal prep assistance, laundry folding, and kitchen upkeep.
safety_note: 100% background and police verified through Women Labour Cooperatives with photo identity cards.
trust_note: Guaranteed fair living wages with zero middleman deductions under Mahila Labour Union.

extra_work.title: Deep Kitchen Cabinet Reorganization & Party Vessel Cleaning
extra_work.description: Thorough sanitisation of pantry shelves, spice jar wipe-down, and scrubbing of extra party/buffet cookware.

name: Driver
description: Professional verified chauffeurs for city commutes, outstation travel, hospital visits, airport transfers, and valet parking.
included: Clean driving history & zero alcohol test
sample_steps: Driver reaches doorstep & verifies vehicle keys
safety_note: Drivers carry valid commercial licences, adhere strictly to speed limits, and wear seatbelts at all times.
trust_note: Affiliated with Delhi Commercial Drivers & Chauffeurs Cooperative Society.

extra_work.title: Extended Waiting Time & Night Driving Surcharge
extra_work.description: Additional 60 minutes waiting duration during return transit or late-night driving slot.

name: Gardener
description: Skilled garden maintenance, lawn mowing, hedge trimming, organic fertilising, pest control, and terrace potting.
safety_note: Only eco-friendly neem-based organic repellents used. Safe for domestic pets and birds.
trust_note: Supported by the Floriculture & Urban Green Labour Cooperative Union.

extra_work.title: High-Branch Tree Pruning & Organic Anti-Fungal Root Treatment
extra_work.description: Trimming hazardous overhanging branches and applying organic neem-cake fungicide to root zones.

helper_request.reason: Moving heavy soil sacks, terrace pots, and operating electric lawn mower across large garden.
